prompt:
Use case stylized-concept. Create a transparent game asset atlas, exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows, 12 separate objects with ample transparent gaps, 1536x1024. Images 1 and 2 are REFERENCE SHEETS of original Pokemon FireRed maps with location names. Reinterpret the specified buildings faithfully as richly layered flat cardstock front elevations, cream cut edges, subtle paper grain, many small window/masonry/roof details. NO generic fantasy castles or gothic flourishes, no full landscapes, no floor shadows, no labels. Each object fits fully inside its cell.
ROW1 from left: 1 Oak laboratory from town_pallet: a LOW ONE-STORY YELLOW facade, broad FLAT GRAY tiled roof with a small red vent, FOUR blue front windows, central blue double entrance, no purple gable and no extra storey. 2 Pokemon Tower from town_lavender: rectangular tall yellow-green facade with pale olive roof, repeated long narrow dark windows in six rows, plain squared architectural stepped parapet, not a spire/church. 3 Pokemon Mansion exterior from town_cinnabar: plain rectangular two-story brown/maroon wood and cream building, broad red-brown tiled roof, straight windows, no gothic towers or ruins. 4 Cinnabar research lab exterior from town_cinnabar: small futuristic white barrel-vault roof, alternating pale yellow/olive arches with one red central stripe, low blue entrance.
ROW2: 5 Celadon department store from town_celadon: tall yellow shop facade, pale green flat stepped roof, regular square blue windows, colorful glass ground-floor doors, no logos. 6 Celadon Mansion apartment exterior: tall pale gray green facade, mint flat roof with small rooftop stair enclosure, repeated blue windows, plain cuboid, not a luxury villa. 7 Silph Co from town_saffron: tall corporate rectangular tan/mint tower, wide horizontal dark blue window rows, FLAT gray roof, broad front central stairs and glass entrance, no skyscraper antenna. 8 Safari entrance Fuchsia: low symmetrical tan building with GREEN flat roof, two shallow lateral wings and central dark entrance, not a castle.
ROW3: 9 One Island Pokemon Network Center from town_one: low white facade with orange curved gabled roof, big round white arch over central blue doors, colored red green blue trim; no big Pokeball sign. 10 Trainer Tower ROOFTOP from trainer_tower: frontal pale mint low terrace parapet with simple yellow horizontal band and two short gray vertical posts, one small red elevator doorway at right, no tower exterior. 11 Sabrina interior divider: short pale purple wall segment with blue lower panels and white-gold trim, room partition, no giant psychic symbols. 12 square exactly top-down BLUE checker tile floor swatch for Pokemon Mart, tiny alternating light/dark blue tiles, straight square boundary.
Style clean handmade paper theater cutouts, front-on with just a hint of top surfaces, high detail and precision. True transparent background.
